Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Leitner & Sohn team,

Thank you for your offer. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today: 30,000 kits a year, binding for 24 months, about four times our business with you today.

Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95.
Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10).

For the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume we propose EUR 4.94 per kit, 24 months, 90 days payment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We highly value the opportunity to supply this complete kit and appreciate the consolidated volume you are offering.
We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract term; however, we propose a 60-day payment period to balance the agreement.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €5.49 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
